name: What is the typical cost range for professional molding installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for professional molding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional molding installation varies significantly based on material, complexity of the design, and the size of the project. Basic pine or MDF baseboards might range from $3 to $7 per linear foot for materials and installation. More intricate crown molding or custom hardwoods can cost $10 to $25 per linear foot or more, including labor. Factors like existing wall conditions, removal of old molding, and painting or finishing will also impact the final price. For an accurate estimate, it's best to schedule an on-site consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional molding installation typically ranges from $3 to $25+ per linear foot, depending on the material, design complexity, and labor costs.
